stages.label: Sensor data
stages.text: Collect, curate and qualify raw sensor recordings.

stages.label: Signal processing
stages.text: Turn noisy signals into meaningful information.

stages.label: Embedded AI
stages.text: Let tiny devices learn, classify and decide on-chip.

stages.label: Validation
stages.text: Prove it works, automatically and continuously.

roles.name: Agile Master
roles.summary: The Agile Master enables agile ways of working by supporting teams, facilitating collaboration, and driving continuous improvement.
roles.quote: I help teams work effectively by fostering agile practices, removing obstacles, and creating an environment for continuous learning and delivery.
tasks: Facilitate agile ceremonies and team collaboration
Support teams in applying agile principles and practices
Remove impediments and foster continuous improvement
Promote transparency, communication, and stakeholder alignment
competence: Ensures effective application of agile methods and frameworks
Supports team performance and continuous improvement
Encourages collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams

roles.name: Computer Science Engineer – Embedded AI
roles.summary: The Computer Science Engineer – Embedded AI develops software solutions that bring AI capabilities onto embedded systems and sensor platforms.
roles.quote: I bring AI closer to the device by developing efficient embedded software solutions for intelligent sensor applications.
tasks: Develop embedded software solutions for AI-enabled sensor applications
Implement and optimize algorithms for constrained embedded environments
Support integration of AI models into software and system architectures
Analyze performance, memory usage, and runtime behavior on target platforms
competence: Strong programming skills for embedded systems and software development
Knowledge of AI, machine learning, and model deployment concepts
Understanding of resource constraints such as memory, latency, and power consumption
Ability to work across software, AI, and system engineering topics

roles.name: Computer Science Expert
roles.summary: The Computer Science Expert develops advanced software concepts and technical solutions that enable innovative digital products and intelligent sensor applications.
roles.quote: I solve complex software challenges by combining computer science expertise, system thinking, and modern software engineering practices.
tasks: Develop software concepts, architectures, and technical solutions
Analyze complex problems and derive scalable approaches
Support implementation of advanced algorithms and software components
Contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement activities
competence: Strong expertise in computer science and software engineering
Knowledge of software architectures, algorithms, and design principles
Analytical problem-solving and system-level thinking capabilities
Ability to collaborate across disciplines and communicate technical concepts

roles.name: Algorithm Technical Lead
roles.summary: The Algorithm Technical Lead drives technical progress and ensures the successful integration of algorithms into robust production software.
roles.quote: I connect algorithms, systems, and software teams by providing technical direction, resolving trade-offs, and driving engineering excellence.
tasks: Connect System Engineering, Algorithm Development, and Software Framework teams
Translate stakeholder and system needs into clear software requirements
Guide algorithm design, implementation, integration, and optimization
Review technical concepts and code while promoting reuse and standardization
competence: Deep expertise in algorithm development and digital signal processing
Strong knowledge of software architecture and embedded development
Systems thinking across sensor data paths and hardware/software interfaces
Technical leadership, structured problem-solving, and clear communication

roles.name: DSP Data Operations Engineer
roles.summary: The DSP Data Operations Engineer manages data pipelines, processing workflows, and analysis environments to support the development and validation of DSP solutions.
roles.quote: I turn raw data into reliable insights by managing data workflows, ensuring data quality, and enabling efficient algorithm development.
tasks: Manage data collection, processing, and storage workflows
Prepare and maintain datasets for algorithm development and validation
Support automation of data analysis and evaluation processes
Monitor data quality and improve operational efficiency
competence: Knowledge of data processing, analytics, and workflow automation
Experience with scripting, databases, and data management tools
Understanding of DSP algorithms and sensor data characteristics
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

roles.name: DSP Embedded Engineer
roles.summary: The DSP Embedded Engineer implements and optimizes signal processing solutions on embedded platforms to enable efficient and reliable sensor applications.
roles.quote: I bring signal processing algorithms onto embedded hardware by optimizing software, performance, and resource usage for real-world products.
tasks: Implement DSP algorithms on embedded platforms and target hardware
Optimize software for performance, memory usage, and power consumption
Integrate signal processing solutions into embedded systems
Support testing, debugging, and validation of embedded implementations
competence: Expertise in embedded software development and programming
Knowledge of digital signal processing and algorithm implementation
Understanding of microcontrollers, processors, and embedded architectures
Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills

roles.name: DSP Engineer
roles.summary: The DSP Engineer develops, implements, and optimizes signal processing algorithms that transform sensor data into meaningful information.
roles.quote: I develop signal processing solutions that enable accurate, efficient, and reliable interpretation of sensor data.
tasks: Develop and optimize signal processing algorithms for sensor applications
Analyze sensor data and evaluate algorithm performance
Support integration, testing, and validation of DSP solutions
Improve robustness, efficiency, and accuracy of signal processing methods
competence: Expertise in digital signal processing and algorithm development
Strong analytical and mathematical problem-solving skills
Knowledge of sensor systems, data analysis, and filtering techniques
Experience with software implementation and validation of DSP concepts

roles.name: Embedded AI Engineer
roles.summary: The Embedded AI Engineer develops and deploys AI solutions for embedded systems, enabling intelligent functionality directly on resource-constrained devices.
roles.quote: I bring artificial intelligence onto embedded platforms by optimizing models, software, and performance for real-world sensor applications.
tasks: Develop and integrate AI and machine learning solutions for embedded devices
Optimize models for performance, memory, and power consumption
Support deployment and validation of AI applications on target hardware
Collaborate with software, DSP, and system engineering teams
competence: Expertise in embedded software development and AI concepts
Knowledge of machine learning model optimization and deployment
Understanding of embedded hardware constraints and performance tuning
Strong analytical and cross-domain problem-solving capabilities

roles.name: Embedded AI Software Architect
roles.summary: The Embedded AI Software Architect defines software architectures that enable AI models to run efficiently and reliably on embedded sensor platforms.
roles.quote: I shape embedded AI software concepts by connecting AI models, software architecture, and hardware constraints into scalable product solutions.
tasks: Define software architectures for embedded AI solutions
Translate AI and product requirements into scalable software concepts
Align model deployment, runtime behavior, and system integration
Guide implementation teams on architecture, interfaces, and technical trade-offs
competence: Strong expertise in software architecture and embedded systems
Knowledge of AI model deployment and optimization concepts
Understanding of hardware constraints, runtime behavior, and interfaces
Ability to guide technical decisions across AI, software, and system teams

roles.name: Product Owner
roles.summary: The Product Owner maximizes product value by defining priorities, managing the product backlog, and aligning stakeholder needs with development goals.
roles.quote: I connect business needs and development teams by turning product visions into clear priorities and valuable software solutions.
tasks: Define and prioritize product backlog items and development goals
Align stakeholder expectations with product and business objectives
Support planning and decision-making throughout the development lifecycle
Ensure delivered solutions create measurable customer and business value
competence: Strong understanding of agile product development and backlog management
Ability to balance customer, business, and technical requirements
Effective stakeholder communication and prioritization skills
Strategic thinking combined with decision-making capabilities

roles.name: Software Architect
roles.summary: The Software Architect defines software architectures and technical concepts that enable scalable, maintainable, and reliable software solutions.
roles.quote: I design software architectures by connecting requirements, technologies, and development teams into a robust technical solution.
tasks: Define software architectures, interfaces, and technical concepts
Translate system and product requirements into software solutions
Guide architectural decisions and technical trade-offs
Support integration and alignment across software development teams
competence: Strong expertise in software architecture and design principles
Understanding of software development lifecycles and methodologies
Ability to balance technical requirements, quality, and complexity- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

roles.name: Software IT Manager
roles.summary: The Software IT Manager ensures that software development teams have the tools, infrastructure, and IT services required to develop, test, and deliver software efficiently.
roles.quote: I enable software teams by providing reliable development environments, IT services, and tools that support efficient engineering workflows.
tasks: Manage software development tools, platforms, and IT environments
Support deployment, maintenance, and operation of software infrastructure
Coordinate IT services and tool improvements with stakeholders
Ensure availability, reliability, and efficiency of development environments
competence: Knowledge of software development environments and IT infrastructure
Understanding of cloud services, DevOps, and tool ecosystems
Experience with system administration, automation, and operations
Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills

roles.name: Software Test Automation Architect
roles.summary: The Software Test Automation Architect defines automation strategies, frameworks, and testing concepts to ensure efficient and scalable software quality assurance.
roles.quote: I shape test automation ecosystems by connecting quality goals, testing frameworks, and development processes into a reliable validation strategy.
tasks: Define test automation architectures, frameworks, and standards
Design scalable automated testing strategies across the software lifecycle
Guide teams in selecting and implementing automation solutions
Drive continuous improvement of testing efficiency and test coverage
competence: Expertise in software test automation and quality engineering
Knowledge of testing frameworks, CI/CD, and DevOps practices
Understanding of software architectures and development processes
Strong analytical, coaching, and stakeholder management skills

roles.name: Software Test Automation Engineer
roles.summary: The Software Test Automation Engineer develops and maintains automated test solutions that ensure software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
roles.quote: I increase software quality by designing, implementing, and running automated tests that provide fast and reliable feedback.
tasks: Develop and maintain automated test cases and test scripts
Execute and analyze automated test runs across development stages
Integrate test automation into CI/CD and development workflows
Investigate defects and improve test coverage and reliability
competence: Experience in software testing and test automation
Knowledge of scripting, programming, and automation frameworks
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and software quality processes
Strong analytical and debugging capabilities

roles.name: Software Tool and Application Engineer
roles.summary: The Software Tool and Application Engineer develops and maintains software tools and applications that support engineering workflows and product development.
roles.quote: I simplify engineering processes by creating tools and applications that improve efficiency, automation, and usability.
tasks: Develop and maintain software tools and engineering applications
Automate workflows and improve development efficiency
Support integration of tools into existing software environments
Analyze user needs and translate them into practical software solutions
competence: Strong software development and programming skills
Knowledge of tool development, automation, and scripting
Understanding of engineering processes and user requirements
Ability to design maintainable and user-friendly software solutions
